newsitem.title: USA: Cons Cigar says expects premium cigar growth.
newsitem.headline: Cons Cigar says expects premium cigar growth.

text.p: Consolidated Cigar Holdings Inc, Wednesday, said its premium cigars were behind the growth in sales in the second quarter and expects the trend to continue.
The company said in a statement that it expects 50 percent of its total 1997 sales to be made up from its line of premium cigars.
The company added that operating margins are also expected to continue their growth as premium cigar demand expands.
Consolidated Cigar said it has committed significant capital funds to increase the capacity of each of its premium manufacturing facilities for fiscal 1998 and beyond.
